answer: Each identity stands on a public ledge of heartbeats: a beacon calls at random, and the agent must echo a fresh compute proof within one epoch or lose its slot. A prism check splits each echo into timing, work and signature, so rented heartbeats fail. Missing three calls burns the bond. One fake costs 60 locked plus 25 compute per epoch, so 1,000 fakes lock 60,000 and burn 25,000 per epoch against a 40,000 pool. Honest agents pay once.
